measures.detail: The field with the web addresses to show. Some sites do not allow being shown inside another page and stay blank: use Open in a new tab.
measures.documentation: The field with the web address (https://...) of the page to show. With the Singleton function a page opens when one record is filtered or selected; Min or Max always shows one. Some sites do not allow being shown inside another page.

showBar.documentation: A bar above the page with its address and an Open in a new tab link. Hidden when the view is under 120 pixels high.

paneX.documentation: Optional: one page per value of this field, side by side.

paneY.documentation: Optional: one page per value of this field, one above the other.
